svg.title: EKF vs UKF
svg.desc: EKF linearizes the function with a tangent; UKF pushes sigma points through unchanged and matches mean and covariance to second order.
svg.text: EKF vs UKF — linearize, or push points through?

EKF replaces the function with a tangent; UKF replaces the distribution with a set of representative points.
No derivatives and second-order accuracy, yet UKF still reports one Gaussian.
